verdict.rationale: Jira is an issue and project tracker. Having an agent navigate an app and capture before-and-after screenshots to verify its own implementation is a capability of a coding or browser-automation agent, not of a work-tracking product. The evidence shows Jira only hands work off to external coding agents ('Assign work to your favorite coding agent from Jira') and serves context via MCP and CLI. Nothing shows Jira itself driving an app or taking screenshots, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
